column1: # Corpus records the x86-64 JIT is known to fail, one per line as
# <record name><TAB><class>. Each class is a correctness gap of the engine,
# not of the record; the JIT corpus test fails when a listed record passes,
# so a fix removes its rows in the same change.
# XSAVE and XRSTOR of MXCSR, XMM and XSTATE_BV: the JIT loads MXCSR when
# XSTATE_BV selects the SSE component, where the hardware loads it when RFBM
# selects the SSE or AVX component; it keeps XMM and YMM_Hi128 for a clear
# XSTATE_BV bit, and XSAVE does not merge the bits outside RFBM into XSTATE_BV.
